A man built a mountain on the roof of a twenty-six storey tower.
Beijing. Zhang Biqing runs acupuncture clinics, and lives on the top floor.
On the roof, he builds a two-storey villa inside fake rocks, trees and bushes.
About eight hundred square metres. Six years of work.
Downstairs, neighbours complain about damaged pipes and late-night parties.
Then, in 2013, photos of the mountain go viral.
Officials give him fifteen days. Tear it down, or they will.
He calls it just a garden. Then he hires about fifty workers to smash it.
The rubble can only go down the lift after ten thirty at night.
Would you want him as a neighbour?
